concepts.name: Counseling Frontend SPA
concepts.summary: React + TypeScript application for askers and consultants: registration, messaging, bookings, and profile flows. Custom webpack build, react-router-dom v5, SCSS/CSS modules with MUI theming; Storybook and Cypress for quality.

concepts.name: Matrix-backed Real-time Communication
concepts.summary: Messaging and live updates run over Matrix (matrix-js-sdk); configureMatrixLogging.ts wires SDK logging, and session chats map to Matrix rooms.

concepts.name: Application Structure
concepts.summary: src is organized into api (HTTP clients incl. generated OpenAPI clients in generated/), components/containers/pages (UI), features and extensions (feature modules), globalState (state management), hooks, and i18n.

flows.name: Asker Registration → First Chat
flows.summary: Asker registers (agency/topic selection) → account and session are created via the backend services → the session's Matrix room connects → messaging UI opens for the first enquiry.
